decision_notes: Approved as an exploratory RNA-topology model. Unit 8 expresses reproducible ISC/crypt markers in both pooled libraries and is the preferred non-mitotic root anchor, while unit 0 represents the adjoining cycling ISC/early-TA state. Units 1 and 3 form a coherent immature-to-mature absorptive arm. The model is descriptive because diet and pooled library are confounded, and root-unit sensitivity must be evaluated before interpreting gene trends.

Approved as an exploratory targeted RNA-topology model from the ISC-like crypt state toward mature goblet and Reg4-positive deep crypt secretory endpoints. The inferred paths connect unit 8 through the immature secretory unit 4, followed by separation toward mature goblet unit 5 or through unit 7 toward Reg4-positive deep crypt secretory unit 9. Units 0 and 6 were excluded because they formed separate crypt-side leaves. Cycling secretory unit 18 was also excluded because the primary unregressed RNA topology placed it on a separate direct 8-to-18 branch rather than between the root and mature secretory endpoints. Diet and pooled library remain confounded, so all diet differences are descriptive.

Root-unit sensitivity analysis using cycling ISC/early-TA unit 0 as the alternative origin while retaining units 8, 6, 1, and 3. This model tests whether absorptive ordering and gene trends remain stable when the root is moved from the non-mitotic ISC-like unit 8 to the adjoining cycling state. Results are sensitivity evidence only and do not supersede the primary unit-8-rooted model.
